title: Workspace Conductor: Compact Switchboard & Cost Lens Prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, single-column workspace switchboard (Workspace Conductor) that surfaces per-workspace routing, quick actions, and a contextual cost lens. This ticket covers exploratory sketches, hi-fi prototype, and a design critique with PM/Eng to align on information architecture, affordances for rollouts, and telemetry hooks. Motivations: reduce cognitive overhead for users who manage multiple workspaces and need fast context switching while keeping cost signals visible without leaving flow. Scope: sidebar + switcher affordance, condensed workspace card pattern, cost-lens micrograph with token-level hover details, and rollout quick-actions (canary, rollback, target routes). Out of scope: billing admin flows, RBAC policy details, and deep analytics dashboards (these will be separate tickets).
activity: 2025-01-10: Kickoff — aligned with PM (Hannah Kim) and Eng lead (Rafiq Ansari). Reviewed telemetry constraints and data availability for per-route cost metrics.

2025-01-13: Low-fi concept sketches posted to Figma; two variants explored: Compact Column (single-stack) and Floating Palette (modal). Design note: Column favored for discoverability and keyboard nav.
2025-01-15: UX research session with 6 internal power users. Key insight: users prefer workspace preview with recent routes and explicit cost delta vs baseline.
2025-01-17: Hi-fi prototype v1 completed — includes workspace cards, cost micrograph, and rollout quick-actions. Prototype link added to attachments.
2025-01-18: Engineering review — ENG flagged concerns on prefix caching telemetry and suggested an API contract for per-route cost samples (ENG-2034). Added dependency.
2025-01-20: PM feedback — request to add frequency-based sorting and an opt-in compact mode for heavy-tenants. Added labels and updated scope.
2025-01-22: Design critique with cross-functional reviewers. Decision: use progressive disclosure for advanced rollout controls; primary actions are switch, view-cost, open-rollout.
2025-01-24: Accessibility pass — updated color tokens for cost micrograph and added keyboard-only interaction flows.
2025-01-25: Preparing handoff package. Awaiting ENG implementation estimate and PM acceptance to move to Planned.
Follow-ups: Create ENG ticket for client-side telemetry hooks (ENG-2089), define analytics events with Data (PM-812), and schedule a session with Security for telemetry PII review if needed.
